question: Up 3 in the last 12 seconds, should the leader foul or defend?
answer: Foul: leader wins 93.6% fouling, 92.4% defending; +2.8 pp at equal time (CI +0.8 to +4.6).
findings: Same-time difference (foul minus defend): +2.8 pp (95% CI +0.8 to +4.6).
Reached OT: foul 6.7%, defend 14.2%. Lost in regulation: foul 3.1%, defend 0.9%.
Leader win rate once in OT: foul 50.7% (n=71), defend 52.7% (n=857).
method: First trailer possession per game that is live with 12 s or less, final regulation period, down 3. Foul = leader's non-shooting foul sending trailer to the line before any shot. Compared within possession-start bins (4-8, 8-12, 12+ s); outcome = game win incl. OT.
data: ESPN play-by-play via sportsdataverse, CBB, 2011-12 to 2025-26, 7,116 games.

chart.title: CBB: leader win % up 3, by seconds left at trailer possession start
chart.x_label: seconds left at possession start (bin middle; 14 = started earlier, live at 12)
